description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or romantic search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale for the user. Does not invent Associates tags — uses server-configured tags per storefront (omit tag= until real IDs are set). OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs produce /dp links on amazon.se and amazon.com (US); other marketplaces get romantic search deep-links.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy / inspiration link
